name: fpmax-observed-support
head: b951b78ba08bb404d58390dc21e6f68fc36b4537
title: Confirm observed support before FPmax maximality pruning
body:
### Description

`fpmax(null_values=True)` can insert a candidate into the maximal-itemset cache before verifying its support over observed transactions. An infrequent candidate then suppresses valid subsets; count-based pruning can also omit frequent supersets when missing-value support is not downward closed.

For `[[1, 1], [1, 0], [NaN, 1]]` at support 0.6, the current implementation returns no itemsets. The correct maximal sets are `{0}` with support 1 and `{1}` with support 2/3; their union has support 1/2.

This change confirms observed-row support before inserting into the maximal-itemset cache, explores rejected candidates' subsets, and uses globally complete rows only as a conservative occurrence-count bound. It keeps positive occurrences separate from missing observations. Maximality is established before `max_len` filters the output. Inputs without missing values keep their existing path. Missing-data searches may examine additional candidates because support is not downward closed.

### Related issues or pull requests

Closes #1316.

Related earlier work: the [FPGrowth missing-support change](https://github.com/Afloat16/mlxtend/commit/e96ccc140c2ecaae13ec08cdc8dce13575739621) handles a separate miner. It explicitly leaves FPmax's maximality cache unchanged. This PR fixes that independent FPmax path. Deduplication covered 692 upstream PR refs, 125 fork heads, and all reachable intermediate changes to the relevant source; no equivalent FPmax fix was found.

### Validation

- Exact upstream base: `1aee767ef57b84a8191511a08955c583b65de382`.
- 125 new regression cases: **40 fail on the unchanged source**, all pass with the patch. The tests compare itemsets and supports to a separate exhaustive oracle, enumerate all three-transaction/two-item tables containing missing entries, and cover randomized thresholds, length limits, labels, input preservation, and conservative count bounds.
- Full frequent-pattern suite: **236 passed**. Full repository suite: **865 passed, 3 skipped**.
- Changed module statement/branch coverage report: **97%**.
- Validation uses Python 3.11.18 and the unchanged frozen dependency lock. Both baseline and candidate are exercised in the same job.
- Complete repository isort/Black checks, changed-file Flake8, `git diff --check`, package build, and strict Twine metadata checks passed. The repository-wide Flake8 report was also collected with its existing findings; it is not presented as a clean lint gate.

[Reproduction, checks, and full test evidence](https://github.com/Afloat16/geoopt/actions/runs/43880428011/job/133344535218).

name: mnist-idx-integrity
head: e1a4bca765f8aed5f24d670f1c4d44a781628b88
title: Validate MNIST IDX headers and declared payload sizes
body:
### Description

`loadlocal_mnist` ignores IDX record counts and magic numbers and reshapes using a fixed 784-pixel width. Matching truncation in both files can silently turn a declared two-record dataset into a one-record dataset, while valid rectangular IDX images cannot be loaded.

This change validates complete headers, the label/image magic numbers, matching record counts, positive image dimensions, and exact payload sizes. Images are reshaped using the dimensions declared in the header. Invalid or truncated data raises `ValueError` before a misleading dataset is returned. NumPy `uint8` output, string/Path inputs, normal 28×28 MNIST files, and valid empty datasets are preserved. Header sizes are checked against bytes actually read, without allocating arrays from an untrusted declared count.

### Related issues or pull requests

Closes #1317. The issue was opened before implementation. The relevant source was checked through all reachable intermediate history from 692 upstream PR refs and 125 fork heads; no previous header/payload-integrity fix was found.

### Validation

- Exact upstream base: `1aee767ef57b84a8191511a08955c583b65de382`.
- 29 new regression cases: **22 fail on the unchanged source**, all pass with the patch. Cases include matching truncation, trailing records/bytes, mismatched counts, wrong magic numbers, incomplete headers, zero dimensions, large declared counts with tiny payloads, rectangular images, Path/string inputs, and empty datasets.
- Complete data-module suite: **44 passed**. Full repository suite: **769 passed, 3 skipped**.
- Changed loader statement/branch coverage report: **100%**.
- Validation uses Python 3.11.18 and the unchanged frozen dependency lock. Both baseline and candidate are exercised in the same job.
- Complete repository isort/Black checks, changed-file Flake8, `git diff --check`, package build, and strict Twine metadata checks passed. The repository-wide Flake8 report was also collected with its existing findings; it is not presented as a clean lint gate.

[Reproduction, checks, and full test evidence](https://github.com/Afloat16/geoopt/actions/runs/43880428011/job/133344534594).
